content: Support of IEEE1722 Stream handling Status: DRAFT Description: IEEE1722 stream access shall be available via Raw Data Stream Rationale: Application need to have the possibility to communicate via IEEE1722 streams in order to handle e.g. audio / video streams. Dependencies: RS_CM_00410 Use Case: An AP application receive audio / video streams to feed local hardware drivers for replaying the received samples Supporting Material: [4, IEEE1722]
